resolutions.title: A Resolution adopting the report of the Committee on Environment on the MOA between the LGU of the City of Bayawan and the Energy Development Corporation relative to the terms and conditions of the domestic wastewater/septage at the Bayawan City Waste Management and Ecology Center.

Approving the terms and conditions of the MOA by and between the LGU of the City of Bayawan, represented by Hon. Mayor John T. Raymond, Jr., and Bayawan Water District (BAWAD) represented by its General Manager, Mrs. Alma L. Abrasaldo, relative to the collection of rent from qualified beneficiaries of the ENZO Town Homes, and further authorizing the Hon. Mayor John T. Raymond, Jr., to enter into the foregoing MOA.
Nomination of Dr. Anelito Bongcawil for the 2025 Presidential GAWAD CES.

Adopting the Commemorative Speech delivered by Hon. Ernesto T. Tijing, the last Municipal Mayor and the first City Mayor of Bayawan, on December 22, 2025 during the Handum Event in celebration of the 25th Silver Anniversary of the City of Bayawan.

Approving the terms and conditions of the MOA by and between the LGU of the City of Bayawan, represented by Hon. Mayor John T. Raymond, Jr., and the EDC represented by its Facility Operations and Management Head, Engr. Liberato S. Virata, and Green Core Geothermal, Inc., represented by its Corporate Support Functions Head, Allan V. Barcena, relative to the treatment of domestic wastewater/septage of the Bayawan City Waste Management and Ecology Center, and further authorizing the Hon. Mayor John T. Raymond, Jr., to enter into the foregoing MOA.

Extending the deadline of Business Permits Processing from January 20 to 31, 2026 to give business owners ample time to transact and process their documents without penalty, considering that there are still a big number of taxpayers who have not renewed their business permits and licenses.
